In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
osteoporosis medications are not effective in patients with CKDs of G4 and G6, and that the data are too sparse to make any recommendation in patients with CK3.
osteoporosis medications are effective for usual indications in G3 CKD patients with normal calcium, PHT, and alkaline phosphate levels.
osteoporosis medications are not effective in patients with G5 CKD and are of uncertain effectiveness in those with G4 CKD.
